title: 2026年高考英语真题1 · 完形填空（A Hometown's Pull 故土的牵引）

hints: 结尾 grateful 和 trust 两个词把情感指向了哪里？
全文反复出现 I / my，作者是站在什么位置讲故事？
回忆故乡时，作者的语气是在控诉还是在眷恋？
why: 首句 I grew up + 尾段感恩收束，是典型的成长回忆型记叙文。
全文以 my classmates / my hometown 视角展开，第一人称亲历叙事。
主角把被误解写成了温暖注脚，基调是怀旧的感恩而非抱怨。

items.label: 主题语境·大类
items.hint: 故事的核心是作者的什么变化——身份认同还是社会规则？
items.why: 离开家乡→重新认识故乡，属于'认识自我与成长'的人与自我主题。

items.label: 主题语境·具体话题
items.hint: 大学经历让作者重新看见了什么？
items.why: 全文由'被误解→离开→读懂故乡'推进，落点是乡情与自我成长。

items.label: 情感线·开端
items.hint: 被同学连珠炮式提问 Do you have to fly home? 时，作者多半是什么感受？
items.why: questions never-ending + a novelty in their eyes——被当稀奇物围观，尴尬又困惑。

items.label: 情感线·收束与主旨
items.correctText: 离开方知故乡珍贵，根会指引前行

opts.text: 离开方知故乡珍贵，根会指引前行

items.hint: trust my small town roots to lead me——作者把故乡放在了什么位置？
items.why: 尾段 trust/lead 点题：根不是包袱，是方向。

paraFuncs.hint: 第一段是在交代什么——故事的起点还是结局？
paraFuncs.why: 去外州上学→被同学当稀奇物，冲突（被误解）在这里埋下。

paraFuncs.hint: complain 之后紧跟的 however，把情感扳向了哪个方向？
paraFuncs.why: 由'抱怨无聊'转为'离开才懂爱'，it took leaving 是全文观点句。

paraFuncs.hint: 慢节奏、邻居如家人——这一段在证明什么？
paraFuncs.why: 用 pace/neighbors/being outside 三个细节支撑'为什么爱'。

paraFuncs.hint: look forward to the visits 和 trust...to lead 把文章带到了哪里？
paraFuncs.why: grateful + trust 收束情感并展望未来，完成闭环。

paraSummaries.summary: Leaving Ohio for college, the writer became a curiosity to classmates who knew little about his home state.
Growing older, he realizes that only after leaving did he understand how much he truly loves his small town.
Small-town life means a slow pace and close bonds, where neighbors feel like an extension of family.
As college years pass, he looks forward to returning and trusts his roots to guide him forward.

trace.stem: The __41__ of how little people knew about Ohio came quickly after I went to school in central Pennsylvania.
trace.correctText: P1 · 同学的夸张提问印证“了解甚少”
trace.correctQuote: “Do you have to fly home? Do you live on a farm?”
trace.hint: 紧随其后的两个问句在演示什么？
trace.why: 提问内容荒诞＝对俄亥俄一无所知，realization（意识到）接事实；fantasy 不搭。

trace.stem: Though I lived __42__ three and a half hours away, most of my classmates thought of Ohio as a whole different world.
trace.correctText: P1 · though 让步：距离近却被视为异世界
opts: P2 · 抱怨与真爱的对照
trace.correctQuote: most of my classmates thought of Ohio as a whole different world
trace.hint: Though 引导的让步句里，前后是'远'还是'近'才构成反差？
trace.why: '只有三小时半车程'却被当作异世界，only 限缩语气制造反差；still/even 无此功能。

trace.stem: I was a __44__ in their eyes.
trace.correctText: P1 · 问个不停→我被当稀奇物
trace.hint: 问题问个不停，我在他们眼里像什么？
trace.why: 没完没了的提问说明作者被当'稀奇物'看——novelty；problem 带贬义，文中并无敌意。

trace.stem: As I grow older, I'm more and more __45__ for my small town roots.
trace.correctText: P4 · 结尾 grateful 呼应感恩
trace.correctQuote: I am grateful for the __54__ that I had growing up
trace.hint: 结尾哪一个词与'越来越____'构成同向呼应？
trace.why: grateful for 与 thankful for 同构同义，情感线贯穿首尾。

trace.stem: Sure, my friends and I loved to __46__ about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere
trace.correctText: P2 · 后半句“离开才懂爱”的反衬
opts: P2 · 抱怨与真爱的对照
trace.correctQuote: I’m convinced that it took __48__ our small town to realize how much we actually loved it
trace.hint: loved to ____ about how bored——少年们爱干的事是什么？
trace.why: 前半句抱怨、后半句深爱的对照，complain about＝吐槽；lie about（撒谎）语义不通。

trace.stem: Sure, my friends and I loved to complain about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere; __47__, as I finish up my junior year of college, I'm convinced that it took leaving our small town to realize how much we actually loved it
trace.correctText: P2 · 抱怨↔深爱的语义转折
trace.correctQuote: how much we actually loved it and what exactly we loved about it
trace.hint: 分号前后的情感方向一致还是相反？
trace.why: 抱怨→深爱是转折，however；therefore 把方向接反。

trace.stem: it took __48__ our small town to realize how much we actually loved it
trace.correctText: P4 · 离乡求学后盼返乡
trace.correctQuote: As I move through my college years
trace.hint: 作者是在小镇里还是离开后才'realize 多爱它'？
trace.why: it took leaving...to realize——离开触发顿悟；protecting/protect 类选项与顿悟逻辑无关。

trace.stem: The pace of life is slow and people __49__ connecting to each other.
trace.correctText: P3 · 邻如家人→重视联结
trace.correctQuote: You do more than just talk to your neighbors—in a lot of cases
trace.hint: 下一句'邻居是家庭的延伸'暗示人们对联结的态度？
trace.why: 慢节奏+邻里如家人→value connecting（重视）；fear 与全文温情基调相反。

trace.stem: in a lot of cases, they're truly an __50__ of your family.
trace.correctText: P3 · 不止交谈→家人般的延伸
trace.correctQuote: You do more than just talk to your neighbors
trace.hint: “不止是聊聊”——邻里关系比普通交谈更深，像家人的什么？
trace.why: more than just talk→关系延伸为家人，extension of your family；advantage/honor 搭配不通。

trace.stem: Much of this __51__ centers around being outside and knowing the ins and outs of the town
trace.correctText: P3 · 慢节奏与邻里联结=生活方式
trace.correctQuote: The pace of life is slow
trace.hint: this 指代的正是上一句描写的什么？
trace.why: this 回指 slow pace / value connecting——统称 lifestyle；procedure 是办事流程。

trace.stem: I am grateful for the __54__ that I had growing up
trace.correctText: P1 · 首句点明成长地→成长经历
trace.correctQuote: I grew up in a little town in northeast Ohio.
trace.hint: grateful for the ____ that I had growing up——在小镇长大给了他什么？
trace.why: growing up 呼应首句成长背景：那段成长经历＝experience；opportunity 无来源。

trace.stem: I can __55__ my small town roots to lead me in the right direction.
trace.correctText: P4 · 无论去向何方→信赖根的指引
trace.correctQuote: wherever my next adventure takes me
trace.hint: trust A to B 是什么意思？作者对根的态度是怀疑还是信赖？
trace.why: trust ... to lead me＝相信根会引路，收束全文感恩基调；challenge 与之相反。

inter.hint: 被误解的经历之后，作者的情感走向了更深一层还是转向别处？
第二段的'抱怨'与第三段的'慢生活之美'是什么关系？
写完小镇之美，情感是不是水到渠成地落到感恩与展望？

intra.correctText: small town roots 呼应首句 little town
intra.hint: 尾短语里的哪个词在第一段就出现过？
intra.why: roots 复现并升级：从地理坐标变成精神指引，首尾闭环。

intra.correctText: 分号后语义反转（抱怨→深爱）
intra.item: 分号 + as I finish up my junior year
intra.hint: 分号前 loved to complain，分号后 convinced that loved it——逻辑方向变了吗？
intra.why: 分号+时间状语引出今昔对照，however 类转折语义由结构承担。

intra.item: pace of life / slow / neighbors / outside / town
intra.hint: 这些词共同描绘了哪个场景的图景？
intra.why: 语义场集中服务'慢节奏邻里生活'，为第④步情节技巧提供语料。

argument.hint: 作者先写抱怨再写深爱，这是哪种推进技巧？
argument.why: 先抑后扬使'离开才懂爱'的顿悟更有说服力。

sentences.kind: 熟词生义:novelty n.新奇的人（物）
sentences.sen: I was a novelty in their eyes.
sentences.ana: novelty 常作'新颖'讲，此处指'被当稀奇物围观'——为前文 questions never-ending 作结。

sentences.kind: 熟词生义:extension n.延伸部分
sentences.sen: they're truly an extension of your family.
sentences.ana: extension 不是'电话分机'，而是'家庭的延伸'——邻里亲如一家的点睛之笔。

sentences.kind: 熟词生义:finish up v.完成；临近结束
sentences.sen: as I finish up my junior year of college
sentences.ana: finish up＝完成、收尾，即'大三快读完了'，暗示时间推移带来视角变化。

rhetoric.sen: I can trust my small town roots to lead me in the right direction.
rhetoric.ana: 呼应首段 I grew up in a little town——从'离开'到'信赖引领'，闭环点题。

rhetoric.sen: “Do you have to fly home? Do you live on a farm?”
rhetoric.ana: 用同学夸张的问话再现误解，幽默中带自嘲，也为 novelty 提供注脚。

corpus.usage: 写'事后领悟'类读后续写的顿悟时刻
描写邻里/友情亲密无间

corpus.en: lead sb in the right direction

items.label: A · 主旨（故事告诉人们）
items.correctText: 离开方知故乡珍贵，根会指引前行
opts: 故乡的根给人认同与指引
items.hint: trust...to lead me in the right direction 揭示了根的什么作用？
items.why: 全文情感线由误解到感恩，落点是根的指引力。

items.label: B · 情感落点
items.hint: grateful 和 trust 两个词各自传递了什么情感？
items.why: grateful（感激经历）+ trust（信赖指引）双词定格最终态度。

items.label: C · 最强支撑
items.correctText: they're truly an extension of your family
opts: they're truly an extension of your family
I lived only three and a half hours away.
Sure, my friends and I loved to complain
items.hint: 哪一句最能证明'小镇联结之深'？
items.why: 邻居＝家人的延伸，直接支撑'为什么爱小镇'。

items.label: D · 读者启示
items.correctText: 成长的养分常在身后，离开方知珍贵
opts: 成长的养分常在身后，离开方知珍贵
外出求学胜过留在家乡
乡下人应当走向大城市
items.hint: 作者的顿悟对你的家乡记忆有什么触动？
items.why: D 题以读者共鸣收束，回扣根与成长的主题。

concepts.def: 根；家族与故乡的渊源——本文标题性概念
乡愁；对往昔时光的怀念
归属感——小镇给作者的身份认同
